name: Ginjou Tomoka
source:
"I believe we need a new battle plan..." 

 The president of the PGG. A talented, yet warm and humble woman. She doesn't know, but she has an innate loveliness to her. 

 Battle quote - "Blitzkrieg, meaning strength through mobility."
[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
